author: bardic-inspiration
name: Cap of Quick Wits
summary: A cap that sharpens recall and the speed of your thinking.
description: A scholar's cap, the sort worn on the way to examinations. The brim is chewed.

stats.effect: While you wear this cap, you can cast *Guidance* from it at will, without needing to provide Components. Once per Long Rest, you can reroll one Intelligence check you just made, and you must use the new roll.
